_gram:
[{#aTarvaRA muninA dfzwaH vedaH aR ATarvaRaH tamaDIte#}
 {#vetti vA aR#} <ls>P. IV. 3. 133</ls>]

_meanings:
.²1 A Brāhmaṇa knowing or studying the Atharvaveda.
.²2 A descendant of Atharvan; {#idaM vE tanmaDu daDyaNNArTavaRo'SviByAmuvAca#}
 <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 5. 16</ls>.
.²3 A priest whose ritual is comprised in the Atharvaveda.
.²4 The Atharvaveda itself ({#aTarvaRAM samUhaH#}).
.²5 A house-priest.

.²1 A private room in which the sacrificer is informed of the happy event
 of the sacrifice by the officiating Brāhmaṇa.
.²2 The black art, magic ({#jAraRamAraRa#}).
<ab>N.</ab> of an Upaniṣad belonging to the Atharvaveda.
